comments.author: Lisa
comments.body:
I can't speak for MSTs, but most recipes require the potential for a resource to be produced: for example, you cannot make Exquisite Fur without a pasture that makes Rabbits, or cannot make Improved Salvage Ropes without a farm that can produce Hemp. They don't need to be actively producing those products, you just need a plot that can produce them.

So while you don't need to be producing blue ore, you need the plot that does (red white blue in savaii, 5-colours in diego garcia)

comments.author: boo
comments.body:
Can be plundered from the Bandit fleet in the following seas:

Ionian Sea
East Mediterranian Sea
Black Sea

It's a small fleet that consists of 2x Galliot & 1x Galley with white sails.
The crew on the Galliots is 20-34 and on the Galley 49-65.
Attack power seems be around 50 and defense around 30.

It's not a rare fleet but the MST drop is.
They appear to give only 1 MST at a time.

They often use Assault so keeping them alive with Guard is a challenge, however the fleet spawns often around places like Benghazi & Salonika.

comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
Important thing to know about this tool:

It can only be used to weapons that HAS a weapon category given "Sword, Ax, Club/Cane, Spear, Throwing Weapon, Gun, Bow, Handgun, Crossbow". In other words, weapons without any of these categories like Divider, Telescopes etc. can't be repaired with this item, only through World Tarot effect.

Hope this helps. :-)
